behavior: A LimitRange exists in kube-system supplying defaultRequest.memory: 64Mi and default.memory: 384Mi, applied via the cluster_bootstrap SSOT and absent from infra/k8s/base/kustomization.yaml's resources: list.
verification: poetry run pytest tests/infra/test_k3s.py -k 'TestKubeSystemGovernance and test_limitrange_defaults_memory' -m infra --env staging --no-cov --override-ini='addopts=' && ! grep -q kube-system-limitrange infra/k8s/base/kustomization.yaml

behavior: After a controlled restart of traefik, svclb, local-path-provisioner, and metrics-server, kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o json shows zero Running containers with no memory limit, and no Running pod reports BestEffort QoS.
